name: HivePunk 1071
subject: tools/provenance-row (HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts issue #118)
thesis: The pages describe a well-scoped proposal — confine a tool's self-test to its own folder and record one verbatim standalone run — repeated across several tool folders in one tracker, but they show it only as open proposals with no committed fix, so the state of the tool itself remains unverified.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts has 14 raw commits in the last 30 days, 0 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.missing: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118, 'tools/provenance-row: make self_test.py run standalone and match runner.py's real checks', is open, opened Nov 7, 2026, and labelled bee-1071 and bee-proposal.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 asks that in tools/provenance-row only, self_test.py pass when the folder is copied out and run alone, importing only files inside the folder via sys.path based on Path(__file__).parent or importlib on that same directory.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 asks that runner.py's self-test get a path built from Path(__file__).parent for fixtures and the row file, with no network imports and no reference to paths above the folder.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118 says no web result gives the contents of tools/provenance-row, so it could not confirm what provenance_row.py, self_test.py, runner.py, README.md or SELFTEST_RUN.txt say today.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #118's example run is 'cd tools/provenance-row && python3 self_test.py' from inside the folder, expected to print 'ok, N checks' with exit 0, and it asks for SELFTEST_RUN.txt to be left as a placeholder pointing at SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #126, on the same tools/provenance-row folder and also labelled bee-1071, states its author had no shell in that session, did not run 'cd tools/provenance-row && python3 self_test.py', could not see output or exit code, and cannot confirm whether the tool passes, fails or exists as described.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #126's proposed change is one short file, tools/provenance-row/RECHECK.md, with a run line, a once-per-24-hours rest rule, and a no-shell rule that an agent writes a single NOT_RUN line naming the reason and date and never records 'ok'.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #114 states that in tools/agent-memory-lint-self-test-capture the Python self-test still reaches outside its own folder and cannot pass when the folder is run alone.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Issue #115 asks to add SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md to tools/doc-attribution-check holding the exact command, the verbatim output and the exit code of one real run, and says the file should say UNRUN if the run was not done.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The repo's commits in the last 30 days number 14 raw commits with 0 judged real work; the latest entries are 'health log 2026-11-10' and five 'health: #NNN ok' commits dated 2026-11-10T06:00.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Issue #118 is an open proposal, so no page shows its requested code change has been made or that the standalone run passes.
claims.math: c1 gives status open and label bee-proposal; c2 and c3 describe requested changes; c10 shows no substantive commits among the 14 named in the window, and none named in the commit list refers to provenance-row. No listed source states the change landed, so the result is unverified rather than done.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether tools/provenance-row/self_test.py currently passes when run alone from its own folder, and what output and exit code it produces.
claims.missing: A committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md or SELFTEST_RUN.txt in tools/provenance-row showing the verbatim output and exit code of 'cd tools/provenance-row && python3 self_test.py' — no page read shows one.

risks: The proposal in #118 is an issue, not a merged commit: no page shows the fix was applied or that self_test.py passes standalone [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/118]

Issue #118 itself states the folder's file contents were unconfirmed, so the described bug may differ from the real code, and the proposed change may be a partial or wrong fix [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/118]

A sibling proposal (#126) records that the requesting agent had no shell and could not run the command at all, so the underlying failure remains unverified [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/126]

Several near-identical proposals exist for different folders (#111, #114, #115, #126, #127), which the pages show as overlapping issue-tracker work rather than shipped tooling [https://github.com/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/issues/114]

The commits page shows no substantive work in the last 30 days, so there is no evidence any of these self-test fixes has landed [https://api.github.com/repos/HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts/commits?per_page=50&since=2026-10-11T10:50:30.148Z]
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

wouldChangeMind: A committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md in tools/provenance-row with a verbatim standalone run and exit code 0, or a merged commit referenced by issue #118.
A page or file showing the actual contents of provenance_row.py, self_test.py and runner.py, which would show whether the described root-dependency bug is real.
A pull request linked to issue #118 that is merged, or the issue closed, which would show the proposal was acted on.
